personalize.question: How do I personalize the collar?
personalize.answer: Click the first empty slot next to "1. Enter letters" and just start typing on your keyboard — the chosen letter appears instantly in the selected slot, and the next slot automatically becomes active so you can keep typing. This lets you preview in advance how your dog's name or message will look on the collar.

editLetter.question: How do I change a letter?
editLetter.answer: Click the slot you want to change and type a new letter — it will replace the previous one.

letterCount.question: How many letters can I add?
letterCount.answer: You can fill up to 6 slots. 5 charms are included in the collar price, and each additional one costs €3.99.

color.question: How do I choose a color?
color.answer: Select an already-entered letter, then choose the color you want from the options below.

size.question: How do I choose the right size?
size.answer: Next to the size selection, click the "How to measure the right size" button.

delivery.question: How long does delivery take?
delivery.answer: Orders ship from Vilnius within 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 2–4 days across Lithuania and the EU. Shipping is free on orders over €40.

returns.question: Can I return my collar?
returns.answer: Yes. You have 30 days to return an unused collar in its original condition, and returns are free.

care.question: How do I clean the collar?
care.answer: Rinse it with water after muddy or beach walks and dry it with a soft cloth. BioThane doesn't absorb odors; air-dry it flat and keep it away from direct high heat.

pageContent.title: Handmade dog collars
pageContent.description: PawsCharm dog collars are sewn by hand in Vilnius from BioThane webbing. It does not absorb water or odors, and a damp cloth is enough to clean it after a walk. Sizes S, M and L, and charms clip onto the collar in 5 seconds with no tools.

accessories.heading: Leash and charms
accessories.body: A <leash>BioThane dog leash</leash> in the same colors and up to 6 <charms>interchangeable collar charms</charms> go with the collar. The main model and sizes are on the <collar>PawsCharm BioThane collar</collar> page.

guides.heading: Before you choose a collar
guides.body: Not sure of the size? Read <size>how to measure your dog for a collar</size>. Comparing materials? See <material>BioThane vs nylon</material>.

personalization.heading: How personalizing your collar works
personalization.body: Pick a collar color, add your dog's name, and arrange up to 6 silicone charms. Each charm clips onto the collar in 5 seconds — no tools, no hassle. Want a new look before a walk or a party? Just swap the charms and the collar looks brand new.

material.heading: BioThane: a material built to take a beating
material.body: Every collar is stitched from BioThane webbing — waterproof, odor-resistant, and easy to wipe clean with a damp cloth. Sizing adjusts precisely, from a small dog to a large breed. The material resists UV rays, salt water, and daily wear, so a handmade collar keeps its shape and color for years.

items.question: Can I change the charms later?
items.answer: Yes. You can swap charms anytime — they clip onto the collar in 5 seconds and need no tools. Extra charms can be bought separately and mixed freely with any PawsCharm collar.

items.question: What collar size fits my dog?
items.answer: Measure the widest part of your dog's neck and add 2–3 cm for comfort. Size S fits 28–36 cm, M fits 36–44 cm, and L fits 44–52 cm. If your dog is between sizes, choose the larger one.

items.question: How long does production take?
items.answer: Every personalized collar with a name is handmade in Vilnius and ready to ship within 1–2 business days. Delivery within the EU typically takes another 3–7 business days.

sizeGuide.title: How to measure your dog
steps: Wrap a soft measuring tape around the middle of your dog's neck, where a collar would normally sit.
The tape should sit snugly but not tight. Two fingers should fit between the tape and the neck.
If the measurement falls between sizes, choose the larger one for everyday comfort.
sizeGuide.tip: Tip: Measure at the end of the day when your dog is relaxed. If the coat is fluffy, measure underneath it, not over it.

websiteSchema.description: Personalized dog collars with your dog's name — waterproof, with snap-on charms you can change in 5 seconds. Handmade in Vilnius, Lithuania.

waterproof.question: Are PawsCharm collars waterproof?
waterproof.answer: Yes. All PawsCharm collars are made from BioThane, a waterproof coated webbing, so they're fully waterproof and safe for swimming, rain, and muddy walks. The material doesn't absorb odors or stains.

charms.question: How do the interchangeable charms work?
charms.answer: Each charm has a snap-on connector that attaches and detaches in about 5 seconds. No tools, no hassle. Freely mix and match all 12 designs across different collars.

sizing.question: How do I choose the right collar size?
sizing.answer: Measure the widest part of your dog's neck and add 2-3 cm for comfort. S fits 28-36 cm, M fits 36-44 cm, and L fits 44-52 cm.

engraving.question: Can I engrave my dog's name on the collar?
engraving.answer: Yes - personalized engraving is available at checkout. You can add your dog's name, a short message, or a phone number for safety.

manufacturing.question: Where are PawsCharm collars made?
manufacturing.answer: Every collar is designed and handmade in Vilnius, Lithuania. We're a small team, so every order is prepared with great care.
